statement: For every r>=2 and r+1<=N<=2r−1 there are explicit regular strict-local punctures with a non-torsion ordinary Gysin image J^(r−1)(Y)→J^r(X); in particular this refutes every odd critical case N=2r−1, and gives a non-torsion kernel for open Chow restriction.
depends_on: C.3e integral cone injection; C.3s CY quotient nonvanishing; explicit weighted Fermat incidence
notes: All equations and an actual smooth projective curve family are specified. No extension to m=r−1 or to every characteristic is claimed.
